newsitem.title: USA: Seimens to supply servers to Intranet.
newsitem.headline: Seimens to supply servers to Intranet.

text.p: Financial Intranet Inc said Tuesday it had signed a deal with a unit of Siemens Nixdorf Informationssysteme AG to get some technology to help start up its financial service.

The company said it had signed memoranda of undertanding with Siemens Pyramid Information Systems Inc of San Jose, California, to get the hardware, software and other components for its On Demand Financial Service.
It did not disclose the terms of the deal.
A spokesman for Financial Intranet said the company planned to start offering its service at home and abroad in the third quarter of 1997.

The service includes video-on-demand interactive training, storage, retrieval and distribution of information on mutual funds, stocks and bonds. It also offers a database with customer and prospect profile information.
